memories.content: Apple is planning its presence at Macworld San Francisco 2007. Steve Jobs is the CEO and a frequent keynote speaker. Apple has not yet publicly confirmed the keynote speaker for the conference.

Macworld San Francisco 2007 is scheduled to take place from January 8 to January 12, 2007. The conference typically features a keynote address on the first day. As of December 1, 2006, Apple has not publicly announced who will deliver the keynote. The organizers and Apple have been in discussions about the keynote speaker, but no official confirmation has been made.
